description:
The story of the previously famous girls' band which is in crisis because of one of them. She got into a sex scandal and their reputation is lost. Their manager is trying to solve it, but unsuccessfully. If they want to sing again, they will have to overcome all the difficulties and challenges of fate.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/sweet_ladys), 
[Ridibooks](https://ridibooks.com/books/1020010269), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000055419), [BookCube](https://www.bookcube.com/toon/detail.asp?webtoon_num=230283)
